Chapter 134 Yan Zhusheng Unleashes Her Full Power

Thursday morning.

After nearly two weeks of morning runs, Li Luo and Ying Chanxi finally decided not to get up early to exercise today, saving their energy and stamina for the upcoming sports meet.

Instead, it was Xu Youyu who knocked on Li Luo's door at six in the morning, calling him to get up for breakfast.

"Did the sun rise in the west?" Li Luo said, rubbing his eyes as he walked out of his bedroom and looked at Xu Youyu. "Senior Sister, don't you usually get up in the last ten minutes?"

"It's the sports meet today," Xu Youyu said, rolling her eyes. "There's a bunch of stuff I have to keep an eye on for the student council. It's better to go early and be safe."

"I see." Li Luo walked into the kitchen, glanced at the leftover rice in the rice cooker and the contents of the fridge, then said, "Let's not make anything complicated then. We'll just have some egg fried rice."

"No problem," Xu Youyu said, following him into the kitchen. "I'll help you crack the eggs."

"Don't get the shells in it again."

"That was last month! Can you stop bringing up old stuff?"

"Alright, alright, hurry up then." Li Luo took a handful of scallions and three sausages from the fridge and prepped them on the cutting board.

Xu Youyu, meanwhile, fumbled to get three or four eggs out. She carefully and earnestly cracked them into a bowl, then used chopsticks to beat them evenly, checking for any eggshells along the way.

"Oh, right, that wrist rest you gave me before," Xu Youyu said to Li Luo after beating the eggs. "I've been using it for a few days, and it feels pretty good. My wrist doesn't hurt as much anymore."

"Good to know it's useful." Li Luo scooped out the rice, poured oil into the wok, and once it was hot, he added the pot of cold rice and began to stir-fry it.

Once the cold rice had been stir-fried into loose, individual grains coated in a layer of oil, he promptly poured in the beaten eggs Xu Youyu had prepared. He then stir-fried vigorously, ensuring the egg mixture coated every grain of rice evenly.

After it took shape, he added the sliced sausages, stir-fried them briefly, sprinkled in the scallions, and the egg fried rice was ready.

"Li Luo, what kind of keyboard do you like?" Xu Youyu asked suddenly from the side as she watched Li Luo portion the egg fried rice onto three plates. "What kind of switches do you prefer?"

"The sound of blue switches is quite nice," Li Luo said. "What's up? Does Senior Sister want to get me a return gift?"

"I'm always eating the food you make for free, and I even accepted your gift. It wouldn't be right if I didn't give you something in return."

Xu Youyu picked up a plate of egg fried rice and, while walking out of the kitchen, turned her head to say to him, "If my mom found out, she'd scold me again for not knowing how to behave and being so inconsiderate."

"There's no need to be so polite. Didn't Senior Sister tutor me too? You even helped me get 27th place in the whole school," Li Luo said with a smile. "And you also promoted me to vice president of the literature club."

Now that Li Luo put it that way, Xu Youyu felt even more embarrassed.

Ying Chanxi deserved credit for the former, and the latter was purely her grabbing Li Luo as free labor. Neither could be considered a favor.

"Anyway, I'm getting you a gift. If you like blue switches, I'll get you one," Xu Youyu said. "I've had my eye on a new keyboard recently, so I'll just buy them together."

"Then I'll thank you in advance."

"You're welcome." Xu Youyu nodded in satisfaction and walked to the dining table. "Also, do you know what Xixi likes?"

"Um..." Faced with this question, Li Luo blinked, his gaze shifting to the row of dolls still arranged on the windowsill. He was momentarily stumped.

But Xu Youyu said, "I heard from Zhusheng that Xixi likes dolls, right?"

"That's what I thought before, too." Li Luo helplessly pointed at the tragic scene on the windowsill. "But it seems that's not the case now."

"But I saw that Xixi really likes the Pikachu that Zhusheng gave her," Xu Youyu said. "She always keeps it on her headboard."

"Is that so?" Li Luo paused, not having noticed this. After all, he rarely ever entered Ying Chanxi's room. "Then maybe she just likes Pikachu."

"I can tell." Xu Youyu grinned and pointed toward the balcony, where the clothes of the three of them were hanging to dry.

Among them, some of Ying Chanxi's undergarments had Pikachu patterns on them.

Li Luo only glanced for a moment before quickly and properly averting his eyes. "I didn't see anything."

"Such a prude." Xu Youyu shot him a look. "I've seen them. Besides Pikachu, there's also Doraemon. If I buy a Doraemon doll, do you think Xixi would like it?"

"...You could give it a try."

Li Luo's mouth twitched. He then checked the time and, seeing that Ying Chanxi wasn't up yet, he got up and walked toward her room. "I'll go wake her."

Arriving at her door, Li Luo knocked. "Time to get up. If you don't get up, I'm coming in."

Knowing that Ying Chanxi always slept in her pajamas, Li Luo had nothing to be shy about. Seeing no movement from within, he opened the door and went inside.

After several months of living here, the bedroom had taken on a very girly style.

From the cartoon desk mat on the desk by the window to the various decorations and trinkets, as well as the giant panda doll on the bed, everything indicated that this was Ying Chanxi's room.

Hearing Li Luo enter the room, Ying Chanxi, who was sleeping on her side, let out a struggling groan, looking like she hadn't gotten enough sleep.

Li Luo walked to the bedside and suddenly recalled what Xu Youyu had said, so he subconsciously glanced at the headboard.

Sure enough, Yan Zhusheng's Pikachu was sitting there quietly. It seemed Ying Chanxi was indeed quite fond of it.

"Time to get up." Li Luo pinched Ying Chanxi's cheek.

Ying Chanxi let out another groan, forced her eyes open, and stretched on the bed. "I know... I'm so tired."

"What time did you sleep last night? You still haven't had enough sleep?"

"A little after two..."

"What were you doing?"

"I was just a bit nervous... I've never run the 1500-meter before, so I couldn't sleep thinking about it."

"I have to perform on stage today and I'm not as nervous as you. You're so pathetic."

"None of your business. You're so annoying."

"So, can you get up now? Or do you want to sleep a little longer?"

"I'm not sleeping anymore. I'll be up right away."

"Alright then, your egg fried rice is already served." As Li Luo said this, he was about to leave, but in the next second, his gaze fell on Ying Chanxi's pillow, and he let out a soft sound of surprise. "What's that on your pillow? It looks a little familiar."

"Huh?" The moment Ying Chanxi heard this, she panicked and quickly pulled the quilt over her head, covering her pillow in the process. "It's nothing, just a pillowcase. I'm going to change. You can go out first."

"Oh, okay." Li Luo didn't think much of it, nodded, and left the bedroom to eat in the living room.

After hearing the sound of Li Luo's departing footsteps, Ying Chanxi's head emerged from under the quilt. She glanced at the small blanket on her pillow and let out a quiet sigh of relief.

Li Luo had given her this blanket when they were children. He probably didn't even remember it himself, seeing as he didn't recognize it.

What an idiot.

With that thought, Ying Chanxi folded the small blanket, placed it on her headboard, then changed into her school uniform, went out of the bedroom to wash up, and came to the living room for breakfast.

Seven in the morning.

The bell at Yuhang No. 1 Affiliated High School rang, and along with it, the "Athletes' March," which was usually played only during flag-raising ceremonies, began to sound.

The entire school, all three grades, a total of 48 classes, began to move to the stirring entrance music.

Class 8's sports representative, Zhu Yufei, led the line. They filed down from the third floor, and when they reached the running track on the sports field, they formed a square formation according to the drills from their physical education classes.

The entrance for the opening ceremony was still a bit dull.

Class 8 of the first year chanted their slogan, "Class 8, Class 8, sharp and unstoppable! Full of fighting spirit, kings of the field!" as they passed the rostrum. They then marched in formation and lined up on the grass field in order.

After all 48 classes had lined up, it was the turn of the school leaders on the rostrum.

The Dean of Students spoke, the Vice Principal spoke, and finally, the Principal spoke.

The one bit of good news was that after the Dean of Students finished his speech, a group of girls from the dance club in vibrant dance dresses rushed out from behind the rostrum and performed a dance on the track.

And after the Vice Principal's speech concluded, it was the anime club's turn. The club members, dressed in various anime mascot and cosplay costumes, performed a rather goofy dance.

"Damn, is this what the anime club usually wears for cosplay?" Zhang Guohuang complained from within the ranks. "Glad I didn't join back then."

Xu Yinghuan, next to him, cast a disdainful look his way, then couldn't help but ask curiously, "Where are the Class President and Zhusheng? Wasn't there supposed to be a performance by the rock club? The principal is almost done speaking, when are they coming out?"

"Saving the best for last, as it should be."

Just as the students of Class 8 were waiting expectantly for Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng to appear, Wei Duo from the second year was also staring at the rostrum.

She used to be the lead singer of the rock club and knew the arrangements for this sports meet. She kept her eyes fixed on the empty space behind the rostrum.

What many students hadn't noticed was that the back half of the rostrum was covered by a large curtain today.

Because the rostrum's surface and walls were all red, the same color as the curtain, many people didn't pay much attention.

Previously, all their attention had been captured by the performances of the dance and anime clubs.

When the school leaders were speaking, not many were willing to crane their necks to look at the rostrum.

But Wei Duo narrowed her eyes, waiting quietly for the principal to finish his speech.

The moment the principal said, "I now declare the 63rd Sports Meet of Yuhang No. 1 Affiliated High School officially open!" what followed was the rhythmic sound of a drum set coming from behind the rostrum.

Tss! Tss! Tss!

Following Niu Qingling's lead-in, the keyboard, guitar, and bass joined the drum's rhythm, launching into the prelude of "Brave Heart."

The second and third-year students had seen the rock club perform before, so they weren't too surprised.

But on the first-year side, many were unaware of the rock club's performance and had just assumed the opening ceremony was over after the principal's announcement.

When the sudden rock music started, everyone was first bewildered, then subconsciously began searching for the source of the sound.

At that moment, a group of student council members had already gone on stage. As the school leaders left, they quickly removed the chairs and desks used for the speeches, clearing the stage.

The next second, the red curtain on the rostrum was slowly raised, revealing the entire band behind it!

Niu Qingling, with a confident and bold smile, tapped away at the drum set with ease and flair, controlling the rhythm of the entire song.

Xie Shuchen stood in another corner, striking what he considered to be a rather cool pose, his fingers tapping the keyboard, pressing out note after note.

Li Luo and Shao Youpeng, like two guards, flanked Yan Zhusheng, one on guitar and the other on bass, starting to sway with the music.

At the same time.

Yan Zhusheng, in the center, also grasped her microphone. She closed her eyes, and her rosy, delicate lips parted slightly with the music:

"I am not a stone"

"Nor am I a teardrop"

"I am just a little bird"

"Searching for the way home"

Sliding smoothly into the early part of the main verse, Yan Zhusheng's clear and bright voice instantly captured the ears of everyone present.

Even Wei Duo was stunned for a moment.

And after the short main verse passed, Yan Zhusheng on stage took a deep breath and abruptly opened her eyes, her crystal-clear gaze looking straight ahead—

"This is the feeling of flight!"

"This is the feeling of freedom!"

"Dancing in the wind in a sky spattered with blood!"

"With a brave heart that never cries!"

The high note, rushing straight to the brain, pierced through everyone's body in an instant.

Even the students of Class 8, who were somewhat prepared, were immediately captivated by Yan Zhusheng's voice.

And the second and third-year students, who already had some expectations, were now also staring somewhat dazedly at the girl on stage, finding it hard to imagine that such an impactful and explosive rock song could be unleashed from the body of such a girl.

"Sounds a bit familiar. Isn't that the one who sang on the sports field during military training?"

"Yeah, yeah, I know her! Her name is Yan Zhusheng!"

"Didn't you give her a drink before? No wonder you remember so clearly."

"Damn! What's wrong with giving her a drink? She's singing so freaking well! I'd go give her one right now."

It wasn't just the boys; even the girls present were instantly drawn to Yan Zhusheng.

Xu Yinghuan, watching Yan Zhusheng on stage from below, couldn't help but exclaim, "That's so cool! You can't tell normally, but as soon as she starts singing, Zhusheng instantly transforms into a cool chick! It's just too cool!"

In her debut as lead singer before the entire school's students and teachers, Yan Zhusheng had conquered almost every listener.

Even Li Luo, who was singing backup for her on the side, or Shao Youpeng, who had a bass solo during the interlude, couldn't match a fraction of Yan Zhusheng's brilliance.

When singing "Blooming Life," after finishing the first chorus, Yan Zhusheng raised her left hand to the back of her head and casually untied her hair tie.

Her waist-length hair cascaded down, dancing in the autumn wind. Yan Zhusheng snatched the microphone from its stand and took a large step forward.

"I want a blooming life!"

"Like standing atop the summit of a rainbow!"

"Like traveling through the brilliant river of stars!"

"Possessing a power that transcends the ordinary!"

The song ended.

Yan Zhusheng's hair was in disarray, and she was panting slightly, the microphone in her hand slowly lowering.

The final note seemed to linger in everyone's ears, reverberating endlessly.

Li Luo and the others put down their instruments and came to Yan Zhusheng's side.

The five of them faced the audience, exchanged smiles, and then, on Niu Qingling's soft "three, two, one," they bowed slightly in unison.

But most people's gazes remained fixed on Yan Zhusheng alone, and it wasn't until her tall, slender back disappeared into the backstage entrance that many reluctantly withdrew their gazes with a sense of loss.

"Only two songs? That's not nearly enough!"

"Forget the sports meet, let's just hold a concert for this girl. I'd even buy a ticket."

"Nice job." Li Luo walked backstage, high-fived Yan Zhusheng, and said with a smile, "That was an amazing performance."

"Mhm." Yan Zhusheng nodded, having already returned to her expressionless mode. She just tilted her head to look at Li Luo and kindly reminded him, "You made several mistakes while playing today, more than usual."

Li Luo's face darkened. "...When will you learn to read the room before you speak."

Yan Zhusheng shook her head, then said seriously, "What I mean is, Classmate Li, you still need to learn from me seriously. I will teach you well."

"Well, thank you so much for that, Teacher Yan."

Yan Zhusheng nodded in satisfaction and patted his shoulder. "You're welcome."

(End of this chapter)
